Why Hud

Deep craft.
Real impact.

Hud is building a runtime code sensor that gives engineers and AI agents real-time visibility into code as it executes – bridging the gap between how code should behave and how it actually does.

If you’re an experienced engineer who gets excited about runtime internals, complex data pipelines, or just loves stretching yourself on tough technical problems – we probably have a spot with your name on it.
